user.title: Notify Hub
user.description: One action for every notification of the house: routed by presence, quiet hours and priority.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Notify Hub is already set up.

menu_options.rules: Rules: quiet hours, duplicates, digests, escalation
menu_options.sources: Sources: rules per integration, captured notifications

rules.title: Notify Hub rules
rules.description: Also editable in the Notify Hub panel (Rules and Settings tabs).

data_description.quiet_enabled: Alerts and infos wait for the end of the quiet hours; critical ones go through.
data_description.dedup_minutes: A notification on the same topic within this time is not sent again (0: never ignored).
data_description.digest_times: When the notifications waiting for the digest are sent, as one message.
data_description.escalation_first: A critical notification nobody acknowledged goes again to everyone after this long.
data_description.escalation_second: Then to the SMS service, this long after it was first sent.
data_description.sms_service: Notify service that sends text messages (e.g. notify.free_mobile), for the last escalation step.
data_description.away_mode: With nobody home, infos go to everyone instead of waiting for the digest.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: One rule per source, keyed by its integration (e.g. hue), automation (automation.…) or text, with any of: name, icon (mdi:…), color (#rrggbb), priority, people, ignore_quiet, dedup_minutes, muted. Also in the panel's Sources tab.

data_description.capture_persistent: The notifications the integrations post in Home Assistant (the sidebar bell) also go through the hub.
data_description.capture_repairs: Each new repair also goes through the hub: an alert for an error, an info for a warning.
data_description.capture_grace_minutes: Captured notifications raised during these minutes after Home Assistant started wait until the end of it, and are dropped if they are gone by then (0: none).
data_description.capture_delay_minutes: Every captured notification waits this long and is sent only if it is still there (0: sent at once).
data_description.capture_rules: A list of rules, the first one matching wins: kind (repair or persistent), domain, id (with * as wildcard, e.g. restart_required_*), then action (send, ignore, journal, digest), delay_minutes and topic (a shared topic: same incident, sent once).

error.invalid_sources: Invalid rule: check the fields, the priority, the icon (mdi:…) and the color (#rrggbb).
error.invalid_capture_rules: Invalid capture rule: check kind, action, delay_minutes and topic.

send.name: Send
send.description: Sends a notification through Notify Hub: routed by presence, quiet hours and priority.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: critical: everyone, through the quiet hours, until acknowledged; alert: people at home; info: people at home, or the digest; digest: the next digest.

topic.name: Topic
topic.description: Two notifications on the same topic close together count as one (default: title and message).

source.name: Source
source.description: Integration, entity or text the notification is filed under (default: found from the calling automation).

people.name: People
people.description: Only these people (default: by priority and presence).

data.name: Data
data.description: Extra data passed to the notify services (mobile app options).

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Acknowledges a critical notification: no more escalation, cleared on the phones.

send_digest.name: Send the digest
send_digest.description: Sends now what waits for the digest.
